decisions.rationale: WF-COMPOSITION: proposed fixed operation composition and typed interfaces only; no runner, registry code or CLI behavior is introduced by this PR.
WF-EXECUTION: proposed structural preflight and current-run producer requirement; negative controls are planned, not implemented or claimed passed.
WF-SOURCE: proposed revision, inventory and tool pin compatibility; existing evidence checks are described, no source policy is changed.
WF-OBSERVATIONS: proposed separation of expected values and fresh observed identities, grounded in the prior ExamCalc pilot; no adapter migration occurs here.
WF-COMPLETION: proposed lifecycle and verification predicate, with gaps and nonempty inventory; existing collector exit semantics and canonical statuses remain unchanged.
WF-REPLAY: proposed fresh-run versus retained replay distinction; execution ownership enforcement is deferred to the bounded implementation.
WF-AUTHORITY: planning preserves existing local evidence and admission boundaries; no new receipt authority, signed artifact or canonical write is introduced.
WF-PILOT: future installed consumer pilot and bypass controls are declared; historical ExamCalc observations are explicitly not this workflow implementation.
